title: URLs without a scheme are rejected instead of defaulting to https
body:
Shortening `example.com` (no scheme) currently fails with `400 invalid url`.

Expected:
- When the submitted URL has no scheme, assume `https://` (e.g. `example.com/docs?x=1` → `https://example.com/docs?x=1`).
- Explicit `http://` URLs must stay `http://`.
- Non-http(s) schemes such as `ftp://` must still be rejected with 400.
- The redirect must use the normalized URL.
